drug_name: Amino Acids / Apis Mellifica / Arnica Montana / Fucus Vesiculosus / Gambogia / Hepar Suis / Phosphoricum Acidum / Pituitaria Glandula Suis / Thuja Occidentalis / Thyroidinum Suis
what_its_for: This is a homeopathic combination product that may be used to support metabolism, thyroid function, and overall glandular health. Some of its ingredients are traditionally used to help with weight management, reduce puffiness or water retention, support energy levels, and promote general wellness. It is not a prescription medication and has not been evaluated by the FDA to treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
how_to_take: Take this product exactly as directed on the package label or as told by your healthcare provider. Most homeopathic products come as small dissolving tablets or liquid drops. If it is in tablet form, place the tablet under your tongue and let it dissolve completely — do not chew or swallow it whole. If it is a liquid, use the dropper provided and place the drops under your tongue or mix into a small amount of water. Try to take it at the same times each day to help you remember. Handle tablets with clean, dry hands and avoid touching them directly if possible — use the cap or a spoon to avoid contaminating the dose.
dosing: A typical adult dose is 1 to 2 tablets or 10 to 15 drops taken 2 to 3 times per day, or as directed on your product label. Dosing can vary by brand and individual product formulation, so always follow the specific instructions on your package. Do not take more than the recommended amount. Children's doses are usually lower — check the label or ask your pharmacist or doctor before giving this product to a child.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and go back to your regular schedule. Do not take two doses at the same time to make up for a missed one. Missing an occasional dose of a homeopathic product is not considered dangerous, but try to stay consistent for the best results.
storage: Store this product at room temperature, between 59°F and 77°F (15°C to 25°C). Keep it away from direct sunlight, heat, and moisture — do not store it in the bathroom medicine cabinet or near the kitchen sink. Keep the lid tightly closed when not in use. Keep all medicines and supplements out of reach of children and pets. Do not use after the expiration date printed on the package. Do not freeze liquid forms of this product.
what_to_avoid: Avoid handling tablets with wet or strongly scented hands, as strong odors (such as camphor, eucalyptus, menthol, or coffee) may interfere with how homeopathic remedies work, according to traditional homeopathic practice. Avoid eating, drinking, or brushing your teeth for at least 15 to 30 minutes before and after taking your dose. Do not take extra doses thinking more will work faster — stick to the recommended amount. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have a thyroid condition (such as hyperthyroidism or hypothyroidism), talk to your doctor before using this product, as some ingredients like Thyroidinum Suis and Fucus Vesiculosus may affect thyroid hormone levels. Avoid using this product as a replacement for prescription thyroid medications without talking to your doctor first.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor or seek medical attention right away if you experience any of the following: signs of an allergic reaction such as hives, swelling of the face or throat, difficulty breathing, or severe rash; chest pain or irregular heartbeat; sudden or severe swelling of your hands, feet, or face; signs of thyroid problems such as rapid heart rate, excessive sweating, tremors, unexplained weight loss, or feeling very hot; signs of worsening symptoms that were there before you started the product; or if you feel no improvement after several weeks of regular use. Always tell your doctor and pharmacist about all supplements and homeopathic products you are taking, especially if you also take prescription thyroid medications, blood thinners, or other supplements.
when_it_works: Homeopathic products work differently for each person. Some people may notice small changes within a few days, while others may need several weeks of consistent use before noticing any benefit. Because homeopathic remedies are very diluted, effects are often gradual and subtle. If you do not notice any improvement after 4 to 6 weeks of regular use, talk to your healthcare provider about whether this product is right for you.
special_populations: Pregnant or breastfeeding women should talk to their doctor before using this product because ingredients such as Thyroidinum Suis, Fucus Vesiculosus, and Thuja Occidentalis may not be safe during pregnancy or nursing. People with diagnosed thyroid conditions (hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism) should use this product only under medical supervision, as some ingredients may affect thyroid hormone levels and interfere with thyroid lab tests or medications. Children: safety and dosing in children has not been well studied for all ingredients — always ask a healthcare provider before giving this product to anyone under 18 years old. Older adults should also consult their doctor before starting this product, especially if they take multiple prescription medications. People with bee or insect venom allergies should be aware that Apis Mellifica is derived from honeybees and should speak with their doctor before use.
